input_rationale.evolution: The candidate extends the merged AstrAI GEMV stack with a rejected broad half-CTA experiment and an evidence-gated exact selector, but has no upstream maintenance history yet.
input_rationale.locality: The CUDA change remains inside the GEMV launcher and one cooperative kernel template; dispatcher, benchmark, tests, and documentation are separately scoped.
input_rationale.tests: The complete CPU-capable AstrAI suite passed (625 passed, 185 skipped) and the built L20 extension passed 140 focused GPU tests.
input_rationale.failure: Unaligned K, unsupported M, training/autograd, unmeasured shapes, other architectures, losing half-CTA cells, and sub-threshold automatic bands fail closed to the existing kernel or PyTorch.
input_rationale.contract: The benchmark and tests are digest-bound, but the D3 acceptance contract has not received maintainer review or a seal.
input_rationale.integration: The fast path remains behind AstrAI's existing bf16_gemv primitive and linear backend.
input_rationale.interface: No public signature or environment-variable contract changes; ASTRAI_GEMV modes remain compatible.
input_rationale.lifecycle: The path remains inference-only, uses the current CUDA stream, fuses optional bias, and is CUDA Graph safe.
input_rationale.buildtest: The SM89 extension built all 128/256-thread row specializations without spills, Ruff format/import checks passed, and both local and L20 tests passed.
input_rationale.policy: The candidate adds no dependency and enables automatic dispatch only for measured architecture/M/(N,K) cells that clear per-shape and chain gates.
input_rationale.attainment: Every newly enabled Qwen2, LLaMA 3 70B, and OPT chain exceeds the 3% gate; losing M/family combinations are explicitly excluded.
input_rationale.coverage: Twenty-two traditional shapes and seven model families were measured in the required NVIDIA L20/SM89 cell; optional A100/SM80 and H100/SM90 cells remain untested and fall back in auto mode.
input_rationale.retention: The exact row/shape half-CTA selector preserves the 256-thread fallback and existing warp-tiled bands; direct A/B evidence and the regression suite passed.
input_rationale.family: Twenty-two LLaMA, Qwen2, OPT, and GPT-NeoX matrix shapes plus seven dependent synthetic chains cover M=1/2/4/8, without claiming a whole-model benchmark.
input_rationale.compile: AOT CUDA compilation completed before timed cases; no compilation is permitted in steady-state timing.
input_rationale.replay: Paired order alternation, warmup, 21 samples, median and p90 are captured, but not seven fresh processes.
input_rationale.load: Distinct-weight dependent chains cover seven model families and include Python dispatch; a real end-to-end service workload was not run.
input_rationale.resource: GPU5 memory and utilization were checked before and after; the co-resident idle AstrAI service remained allocated and is disclosed.
input_rationale.coldsteady: Precompile and steady-state phases are separated, but cold-start latency is not part of the checked-in result.

execution.astrai_lint: ruff format and import-order checks passed
execution.sm89_build: bf16_gemv target built successfully; 128/256-thread cooperative specializations used 26-52 registers, one barrier, and zero spills; M=4 warp tiling used 42 registers, zero barriers, and zero spills
